development: The first matched-byte pilot identified complementary color and layout failures. The new decision rule is exploratory with respect to that pilot.
calibration: Reuse only its 40 calibration prompts. For each of the two histogram blocks of hybrid96_48 (96 global chroma, 48 layout), normalize decoded integer counts within that block, then calculate Hellinger distances. From the 1280 calibration edited-query/wrong-seed pairs estimate the marginal lower-tail probability p=(1+count(null_distance<=d))/(1280+1). Score a proposed identity by p_color*p_layout. Fit a single cutoff at the 95th percentile (inverted empirical CDF) of genuine calibration scores. The product is a ranking score; no independence model or analytic combined false-alarm guarantee.
confirmation: 60 further prompts (30 COCO, 30 SDP), excluding both first-pilot and earlier reference cohorts by dataset/source id, normalized prompt, CLIP tokens and near-duplicate rule. Two fresh seeds each. All are confirmation. Same generator, edit grid, shared pair edit seeds, packed 288-byte references and 120-image gallery. Compare original joint-histogram distance, layout-only and the product on the exact same queries. Freeze numerical cutoffs from the 40 calibration prompts before confirmation scoring.
outcomes: All-edit and 1.8x-contrast genuine acceptance, same-prompt sibling acceptance and gallery top-1. Report independent results at frozen thresholds and descriptive achieved-95%-genuine ROC. Paired stratified 5000-prompt bootstrap of differences with fixed cutoffs. Report actual clean-sibling acceptance. No additional rules or retuning.
